the fact, that the existing model of accounting for leases is not suitable for the recording of long-term lease contracts, especially for leases where the risks are transferred to the lessor and the lease is not recorded as an asset.

the fact that the current model is not suitable for the recording of long-term leases, and that the approach of derecognition of assets from the lessor’s assets is not applicable for short-term leases.
the question whether it is necessary to apply different approaches in recording of lease contracts to the lessee and to the lessor.

it is necessary to create a new approach that is symmetrical to the approach of the lessee, but at the same time is able to display the real situation of the lessor, and that it is necessary in the future to create an approach for recording leases on both sides of the contract, which would be symmetrical and would display the real situation.

the current model of recording operating lease on the side of the lessor is not satisfactory and that it is not possible in the current form to apply only one method, without gross distortion of financial position of the lessors.

the lessor’s income statement should be based on the same principles as the lessee’s income statement.
